label: dense near-always-on feature (all steps after t=0); strongest around outputs of k/r
explanation: Fires on ~93% of all steps in every sequence, flat across phase, L, input token, recall index and history variables (lift ~1.0x everywhere). The only clear gap is t=0 (50% active, low mass); activity also rises from the early original phase (to_go large) toward the end. The trivial predicate t >= 1 gives dev F1 0.96 (mass recall 0.99), but that only reflects density, not selectivity. Magnitude: the top activations are dominated by copy/delimiter steps where k or r is being output now or next (out_tok/next_out in {k,r} are 100% active and hold an outsized share of mass, but as a predicate they cover only ~14% of mass), and by late original-phase steps in sequences containing k/r. Low-quartile activations are scattered across ordinary sequences with no k/r. No selective structure was found that explains the firing itself.
